0.0.1.description:
Setup guide: 
- Download UE4SS from here: https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental-latest
- Put the ue4ss folder contents in Super Meat Boy 3D>SMB>Binaries>Win64
- Put the SMB3DArchipelago folder in the Mods folder
- In the mods.txt, add on the list of active mods by putting the text in unique line "SMB3DArchipelago : 1" (Without quotes)
- Install the apworld if you are generating, or share it with the person generating
- Open SMB3D-Archipelago-Client-1.0.0.exe, connect and launch game

FEATURES:
- Death Link Amnesty up to 100
- Checks for every level, dark world, A+ check, bandage, bosses, and warp zones
- Tofu Traps :)
- yaml is customizable to have anywhere from 80-385 checks.
